hook: Your ferry ride ends at an empty concrete city.
title: The Empty Concrete City In The Sea
description:
Hashima Island in Japan is a concrete city that was abandoned in 1974. It is nicknamed Battleship Island because of its shape, and it still sits empty in the sea.

Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.
comment_prompt: Would you visit? Yes or no
